A Clodsire Mass Outbreak | POKÉTOON Short
After coming across a group of Paldean Wooper and Clodsire, a surprised young girl panics when the Pokémon begin to gather around her! Suddenly, they notice the Wooper plush she’s carrying...and their reaction is something she never expected!
Packed with Paldean Wooper and Clodsire, this endlessly rewatchable episode is dedicated to all of their fans!
